_meta.description: NuvoVet diagnosis codebook (NVD). Seed set of high-frequency small-animal diagnoses in Korean claims. 'mafra_standard_ref' is reserved for mapping onto MAFRA '동물 진료의 권장 표준' disease names (3,511 coded, 2025-04 revision).
_meta.review_status: unreviewed — expected drug classes and atypical procedures are clinical heuristics that must be reviewed by a DVM advisory panel before production use

condition_groups._note: Groups for waiting periods (e.g. patella_hip: 365 days), riders (skin, patella_hip, dental) and exclusion riders (부담보). Which groups a product gates is product data, not codebook data. KB 금쪽같은 펫 excludes patellar luxation and hip disease for 1 year (docs/research); Samsung sells skin and knee-joint (슬관절) riders separately — whether a product's knee rider also covers cruciate disease is product-specific, so cruciate is its own group.

_meta.specificity: 'diagnosis' (a disease) or 'symptom' (a presenting sign such as 구토; the matcher prefers a disease term on near-ties, and a symptom-only claim is a candidate for a 진단서 request).

mafra_standard_ref_format._note: null until the MAFRA '동물 진료의 권장 표준' disease table (3,511 coded, 2025-04 revision) is ingested. MAFRA codes look like 'DH10.56': species letter + KCD-like core + cause digits.

changelog: 2026.10.1: body_system, condition_group, specificity, congenital on every code; +25 codes (19 diseases, 6 symptom-level); symptom words moved off NVD-GI-001 to NVD-SYM-002/003; mafra_standard_ref structured as {species_prefix, code, version}|null.

2026.10.1 (review 2026-10-02): removed over-broad synonyms (포도, 구충, 접종, 백신, 고관절, 고관절탈구); '간질' no longer matches inside '간질성'; heartworm test names are not the disease; +외이도염, +MPL; +NVD-INF-005 feline panleukopenia (cat '파보'/'범백' was coded as canine parvovirus).
